stories.title: Saudi Arabia overturns OIC award in London
stories.summary: A London court has set aside a US$100 million award won by Qatari investors against Saudi Arabia, finding that the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation investment agreement contained only a “conditional” offer to arbitrate, which had not been triggered.
